question: Tocilizumab used against Rheumatoid arthritis is a monoclonal antibody against :
analysis: Tocilizumab is a monoclonal antibody specifically designed to bind to the interleukin-6 receptor (IL-6R). By inhibiting this receptor, tocilizumab blocks the pro-inflammatory effects of interleukin-6 (IL-6), a cytokine involved in the inflammatory process of rheumatoid arthritis.
